campaigns.name: Manila Wine Collector's Choice
campaigns.headline: A Philippines Edition, Chosen by You
campaigns.intro_copy: We are exploring a new Manila Wine collector’s edition inspired by the Philippines—only 100 individually numbered bottles. Before production begins, we are inviting our community to choose the design.
campaigns.story_copy: This edition is being created for collectors who want something genuinely rare and distinctly Filipino. Review each concept, choose the design that speaks to you, and help decide which artwork moves forward. Only one vote is allowed per person.

designs.title: Concept 01 — Archipelago Heritage
designs.subtitle: Flora, Fauna & Sunburst Gold
designs.description: Lush tropical foliage and Philippine biodiversity intertwined with baroque filigree and the iconic Philippine eight-rayed sun in lustrous embossed gold.
designs.alt_text: Four views of Johnnie Walker Blue Label bottle featuring golden Philippine flora, sunburst motif, and exotic fauna illustration on deep amber glass.

designs.title: Concept 02 — Pearl of the Orient
designs.subtitle: Maritime Azure & Coral Reefs
designs.description: Deep oceanic cobalt and cerulean gradients depicting Tubbataha Reefs and Philippine marine sanctuary life across the four bottle facets.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle with vibrant turquoise and cobalt blue marine life, coral reefs, and oceanic waves wrapped around the square glass.

designs.title: Concept 03 — Indigenous Tapestry
designs.subtitle: Yakan & Inabel Geometric Weaves
designs.description: Honoring centuries of Philippine master weavers with intricate geometric Inabel and Yakan tribal patterns rendered in etched gold and rich ruby pigments.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring traditional Philippine handwoven geometric tapestry patterns in gold and deep crimson.

designs.title: Concept 04 — Manila Sunset Elegance
designs.subtitle: Golden Hour Over Manila Bay
designs.description: Warm cinnabar, ochre, and burnished gold gradients capturing the legendary sunset of Manila Bay with historic Spanish colonial arches.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle showcasing a dramatic Manila Bay sunset gradient in warm gold, terracotta, and amber with silhouettes of Intramuros.

designs.title: Concept 05 — Fort Santiago & Intramuros
designs.subtitle: The Walled City Heritage
designs.description: Weathered Spanish stonework, neoclassical balustrades, and historic ironwork silhouettes paying tribute to Intramuros and Manila’s four-hundred-year chronicle.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle with Spanish colonial stone bastion gates, ornate wrought-iron lanterns, and neoclassical arches etched in gold.

designs.title: Concept 06 — King of the Road
designs.subtitle: Jeepney Chrome & Chromatic Pop-Art
designs.description: Dynamic chrome filigree and vibrant festival hues celebrating the irrepressible Philippine jeepney—an enduring monument to ingenuity and urban mobility.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle showcasing ornate chrome hood ornaments, festive hand-painted typography, and vibrant fiesta ribbons of the Philippine jeepney.

designs.title: Concept 07 — Bohol Sanctuary
designs.subtitle: Chocolate Hills & The Nocturnal Tarsier
designs.description: The surreal conical mounds of Bohol cloaked in seasonal bronze hues, cradling the nocturnal Philippine tarsier nestled among dew-kissed emerald fronds.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle with rolling chocolate hills and wide-eyed Philippine tarsier clinging to bamboo shoots in sepia and olive tones.

designs.title: Concept 08 — Stairways to Heaven
designs.subtitle: Ifugao Rice Terraces of Banaue
designs.description: Two thousand years of ancestral engineering rendered in rippling emerald and gold contours ascending through mist-shrouded Cordillera peaks.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring stepped terraces carved into mountain slopes with mist clouds and morning sunlight rendered in green and gold leaf.

designs.title: Concept 09 — The Perfect Cone
designs.subtitle: Mayon Volcano & Albay Horizon
designs.description: The legendary symmetry of Mount Mayon rising in volcanic majesty against dusk skies, with ember filigree and fertile Bicol volcanic soils below.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle presenting symmetrical volcanic cone with wisps of smoke, Cagsawa ruins silhouette, and twilight violet and terracotta sky.

designs.title: Concept 10 — Lord of the Skies
designs.subtitle: The Sovereign Philippine Eagle
designs.description: Spanning four facets, the magnificent Haribon spreads its crowned crest across ancient dipterocarp forest canopies in etched burnished platinum and gold.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle depicting majestic Philippine eagle with outspread feathers and crowned crest over tropical mountain rainforest canopy.

designs.title: Concept 11 — The Pintados Warriors
designs.subtitle: Ancient Visayan Tattoo Mastery
designs.description: Bold geometric body-art of pre-colonial Visayan warriors, depicting bravery, spiritual protection, and sacred ancestral lineages hand-etched in gold leaf.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle adorned with sharp geometric Visayan tribal tattoo patterns, sacred solar emblems, and protective warrior talismans in gold.

designs.title: Concept 12 — Butanding & Sovereign Eagle
designs.subtitle: Gentle Giants, Mountain Terraces & Coral Bays
designs.description: A majestic fusion of Philippine apex wonders: the gentle Whale Shark gliding through coral sanctuaries, crowned Philippine Eagle soaring over rice terraces, carabao, and festive jeepney.
designs.alt_text: Four views of Johnnie Walker bottle illustrated with whale shark, Philippine eagle, carabao, and Banaue terraces.

designs.title: Concept 13 — Parol & Capiz Luminescence
designs.subtitle: Stained Glass Cathedral & Golden Sunburst
designs.description: A radiant architectural celebration of Philippine festive light, featuring translucent Capiz shell tessellations, cathedral stained-glass geometry, and an eight-rayed sun in brilliant jewel tones.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring glowing Capiz shell star, stained-glass mosaic panels, and golden Philippine sunburst.

designs.title: Concept 14 — Habi & Hardcourt
designs.subtitle: Ancestral Weaving & Barangay Basketball
designs.description: An authentic portrait of modern Philippine life blending the timeless art of indigenous loom weaving with the nation’s heartbeat passion for neighborhood basketball, tarsiers, and colorful jeepneys.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring ancestral woven ribbon flowing into a basketball court with Mayon volcano, jeepney, and tarsier.

designs.title: Concept 15 — Treasures of the Philippines
designs.subtitle: Mayon, Intramuros, Vinta & Manila Jeepney
designs.description: The definitive panoramic journey through Philippine identity: Mayon Volcano, Banaue terraces, Intramuros colonial kalesa, vibrant jeepney, Bohol tarsier, and sunset sailing Vinta in rich collector presentation.
designs.alt_text: Four views of Johnnie Walker Blue Label Treasures of the Philippines collector edition bottle on silver-reflective luxury studio setting.

designs.title: Concept 16 — Bakunawa The Moon Eater
designs.subtitle: Celestial Serpent & Lunar Constellations
designs.description: The mythical Philippine cosmic dragon Bakunawa emerging from deep cerulean ocean waves, encircling lunar phases and starry constellations across the four facets of the bottle in lustrous gold and lapis lazuli.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring the mythological Bakunawa sea serpent coiling around lunar phases with gold scales and starry night sky.

designs.title: Concept 17 — Ani Golden Harvest
designs.subtitle: Carabao, Emerald Terraces & Christmas Parol
designs.description: A celebration of community bounty and Philippine folk-art spirit, featuring the revered water buffalo in blue porcelain filigree, emerald Cordillera paddies, festive jeepney riders, and a glowing Christmas star.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring water buffalo with filigree motifs, terraced rice paddies, joyful jeepney, and festive Christmas parol.

designs.title: Concept 18 — Sarimanok Messenger of Fortune
designs.subtitle: Maranao Royal Plumes & Golden Okir
designs.description: The legendary Maranao totem bird of good fortune and prosperity, adorned with flowing jewel-toned plumes of emerald, sapphire, and ruby, grasping a silver fish amidst golden okir scrolls and the crescent moon.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring the mythological Sarimanok bird with vibrant okir filigree feathers, golden sun, and crescent moon.

designs.title: Concept 19 — Tinikling & Mayon Sunset
designs.subtitle: National Bamboo Dance & Soaring Haribon
designs.description: Capturing the rhythmic grace of the Tinikling bamboo dancers in traditional baro't saya, accompanied by kulintang gongs, the sovereign Philippine eagle, and a vibrant Vinta gliding before Mount Mayon.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle depicting Tinikling bamboo dancers, Philippine eagle in flight, colorful Vinta boat, and fiery Mayon sunset.

designs.title: Concept 20 — Palawan Marine & Wild Sanctuaries
designs.subtitle: Dugong, Sea Turtle, Tamaraw & Philippine Crocodile
designs.description: An extraordinary tribute to the Philippines' most endangered and sacred wildlife, featuring the rare Palawan Dugong, hawksbill sea turtle, Mindoro tamaraw, Philippine eagle, and Mindoro freshwater crocodile.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring underwater ocean life with dugong and sea turtle on one side, and rainforest with eagle, tamaraw, and crocodile on the other.

designs.title: Concept 21 — MassKara & Singkil Royalty
designs.subtitle: Bacolod Smiling Masks & Royal Fan Dance
designs.description: Vibrant cultural pageantry honoring Bacolod's world-famous MassKara Festival smiling mask adorned in feathers and Capiz shells, alongside the royal Singkil princess dance and kulintang gong ensemble.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring elaborate MassKara festival mask, Singkil royal fan dancers, kulintang musicians, and shimmering Capiz shell accents.

designs.title: Concept 22 — Bayanihan & Heart of the Game
designs.subtitle: Tarsier, Terraces & Neighborhood Passion
designs.description: A striking contemporary celebration of the Filipino spirit, connecting ancestral mountain heritage, lush tropical highlands, and delicate tarsiers with the vibrant urban heartbeat of barangay basketball and artisan weaving.
designs.alt_text: Four views of Johnnie Walker Blue Label bottle featuring weaving hands, tarsier in rice terraces, and basketball player shooting under Christmas parol.
